pages.en: Grandpa has a farm with twenty sheep. One evening he says, "Lily, how many sheep are in the field?"
pages.zh: 爷爷有一个农场，养了二十只羊。一天傍晚，他说：“Lily，田里有几只羊？”
pages.scene: A green farm field in the evening, Grandpa and Lily leaning on a wooden gate, a group of white sheep in the field, Max beside them.

pages.en: "One, two, three ... nineteen," says Lily. She looks again. "Nineteen! One sheep is not here!"
pages.zh: “一、二、三……十九，”Lily 说。她又看了一遍。“十九只！少了一只羊！”
pages.scene: Lily pointing at the sheep one by one as they go through the gate, Grandpa watching with a worried face.

pages.en: Max runs up the hill. There is the twentieth sheep, with a baby sheep! "Now we have one more!" laughs Grandpa.
pages.zh: Max 跑上小山。第二十只羊就在那儿，身边还有一只小羊！“现在我们又多了一只！”爷爷笑着说。
pages.scene: On a small hill, Max barking happily next to a sheep and a tiny new lamb, Lily and Grandpa running up the hill smiling.

questions.q: How many sheep does Grandpa have at first?
questions.zh: 爷爷一开始有多少只羊？
是 Tom 找到了那只羊。
